title: CSS loader edits remained stale until the development server restarted
steps: Start an App Router application using the Tailwind Turbopack CSS loader.
Change CSS text colours and inspect computed styles in fresh browser contexts.
observed: Fresh browser contexts repeatedly used the previous colour values.
Restarting the development server applied the edited colours.
expected: New requests should use the current CSS after an edit.
comparison: Removing the unused custom loader and using native CSS avoided the stale-style behaviour.
